composition: Lake Davos promenade looking along the water toward the valley peaks · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The promenade along Lake Davos follows the shore, with conifers, the long water, and the town spread on the valley side, while higher peaks close the valley. At about 1560 metres in late September the path is free of winter snow, and the larches are only beginning to turn. This is the lake walk, not a ski-season street. The Open-Meteo model sets the afternoon light.
